content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Kancheepuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://kancheepuram.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DCPU Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk and Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies. One post is for Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk and the other is for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk position, candidates must have passed the 10th Standard or its equivalent. Preference will be given to those with typing certificates and computer proficiency.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years for all the posts announced by DCPU Kancheepuram.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Office Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 13,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DCPU Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DCPU Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be done by the District Selection Committee in accordance with the Mission Vatsalya guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit Kancheepuram, which is https://kancheepuram.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates as specified in the official notification.
